purpose: Create a lightweight, chart-reviewable stock-event mother for the unresolved dispersion/relative-value mechanism. This is not a rerun of the failed MKT-DISP-RANK-001/002 full daily rank builders: it uses one weekly ALL_A/NON_ST view, one horizon, and one representative security per selected PIT industry.
economic_question: When causal cross-industry return dispersion is unusually high, does the representative stock of a currently strong industry continue, or does the representative stock of a currently weak industry repair?

causal_market_structure.decision_clock: completed Friday daily bars at decision_at; holiday weeks without a Friday observation generate no decision
causal_market_structure.eligible_security: hard_valid, current_valid, current_day_data_tradable, market_rule_valid, corporate_action_valid, no blocking/current corporate action, valid historical identity and PIT industry, non-ST, available_at <= decision_at, positive coordinate prices, and exact valid prior-60 history
causal_market_structure.industry_score: median signal-session step_return among eligible current PIT-industry members
causal_market_structure.high_dispersion: current dispersion >= the 80th percentile of the 252 completed market observations strictly before the decision, requiring all 252 prior observations

direction_lanes.CONTINUATION: industries in the current top quintile of industry_score
direction_lanes.REVERSAL: industries in the current bottom quintile of industry_score

causal_market_structure.representative_stock: within each selected industry/date choose the eligible stock with minimum absolute difference between step_return and industry_score; break ties by larger current amount, then lexical symbol
causal_market_structure.reason_for_representative: measure the common industry move rather than an outcome-picked extreme or lottery spike

event_lifecycle.entry: first legal non-limit-up open in signal+1 through signal+3; never the signal bar
event_lifecycle.exit: first legal session whose coordinate high reaches target, otherwise first legal sellable open at or after the horizon
event_lifecycle.execution_contract: trading status, price limits, suspensions, coordinate lineage, and corporate actions fail closed exactly as in recent accepted daily event replays

chart_plan.window: 126 completed sessions before through 126 after signal, bounded by 2013-01-01 and 2021-06-30
chart_plan.manual_review: review every chronological sheet before freezing any chart-compressed rules

development_gate_after_chart_compression.later_data: open 2022-2024 exactly once only after the frozen chart rules pass both annual gates

prohibited: post-2021 outcome use during mother/chart compression
